description: Create a product from a JSON body. The server queues an initial keyword plan. Agree the details with the user first, and quote a product slot with billing_purchase_products_quote when the limit is reached. Creation queues about 30 days of keywords: poll keywords_generation_status.

body.description: Request body as a JSON object. All fields are required: name (2-50 chars), url, description (50-8000 chars), target_audiences (3-7 texts), language, keyword_region (for example us, uk, global-us), competitors (3-7 of { name, link }).

keyword_region.description: Country code such as us, uk or global-us.

target_audiences.description: 3-7 audience texts of at most 200 characters each; replaces the list.
